knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A drawing does not prove clearance, and shared routes need reassessment.
Spread outside the boundary requires reassessment and escalation.

practicalCriteria: On a fictional floor plan, the learner marks the four zones, the stop points and the access controls. Pass: all four zones and at least one stop point are marked.
The learner writes three reassessment triggers for the plan. Pass: each trigger names an action.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A shared route is used without reassessment.
Public access to the zone is observed.
